priority.description: Priority hint. Closed enum: small, stable vocabulary.

assignee.description: Agent or person assigned to work on this task. Free-form because the agent roster is dynamic.

owner.description: Agent or person who owns/verifies this task. Free-form because owners include both agents and humans (e.g. 'user').

type.description: Task category. Closed enum: well-known finite set; new categories require a schema bump (intentional, supports schema-derived tooling).
